name: vikunja-tasks
description: A live Vikunja pane for Claude Code: the Doing, Blocked and To-Do lanes, the task the session is working on, and a button to start a session on a task in its folder

webUrl.title: Vikunja web address
webUrl.description: Where a task opens in the browser, e.g. https://tasks.example.com. Must be https; leave empty for no link.

folderRoot.title: Folder root
folderRoot.description: The directory every task folder lives directly under, e.g. D:\ or /home/me/code. Leave empty to turn the folder picker off.

hiddenProjects.title: Hidden projects
hiddenProjects.description: Text in the title of a top-level project to leave out of the lists by default, with everything under it.
